title: ClassifyBody
description:
The `POST /v1/classify` request body (EST-363): classification WITHOUT
submission, for a shadow-mode witness such as `sockets/harness-hook`
(`sockets/harness-hook/docs/edge.md`, Leg 2).

The same `(agent, verb, params)` `POST /v1/actions` classifies on, plus the
hash of the payload the caller would have submitted. reflexd never sees
the payload itself. Unknown fields are refused: a body that carries a
`payload` is a submission sent to the wrong route.

agent.description: The calling agent, self-declared as on `POST /v1/actions`.

params.description:
The params the classifier reads (`target`, `amount`,
`recipient_class`, …). Left out, the call is classified as one that
declares none, which fails closed where a posture rule needs them.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the payload: 64 lowercase hex characters, no prefix.

Amount.description:
A monetary amount for `spend` classification, in minor units of a currency
(cents for USD). Compared against founder-set soft/hard caps by the
classifier.

minor_units.description: Minor units — cents for USD, pence for GBP, etc.

RecipientClass.description:
A recipient classification a policy can gate `send-external` on
(`spend(<$500, known-vendor)`, soma §5.1; `"known-counterparty"`, §8).

The taxonomy is closed on purpose: an unrecognized recipient class fails to
deserialize rather than silently classifying as benign.

oneOf.description: Inside the org — internal writes, colleagues.
A vendor already on the books.
A counterparty in an existing engagement (soma §8 example).
No prior relationship — the most conservative outbound class.

Verb.description:
The starter verb taxonomy for instance #0 (soma §5.1).

Serializes kebab-case to match the wire (`file-internal`, `send-external`,
`hire-engage`, `grant-access`, `delete-destroy`, `commit-code`).

oneOf.description: Delegated to terrarium's existing commit gates (soma §5.1).

VerbParams.description:
Parameters a verb carries that policies gate on (soma §5.1: "amount,
recipient class, visibility"). Every field is optional — a `read` carries
none, a `spend` carries an `amount`, a `send-external` a `recipient_class`.

`None` fields are omitted from the wire (`skip_serializing_if`) so the
serialized `params` object stays as tight as the §8 examples.

target.description:
The resource acted on, as the submitter declares it. reflexd seals an
action whose target names its own policy or state as NEVER
(`reflex::classifier::ProtectedTargets`, EST-459). Self-declared, so
that rule is a second line: it stops an honest or mistaken agent, and
the structural barriers are elsewhere (EST-460).

visibility.description: For `publish` — how widely it is exposed.

Visibility.description: Payload visibility a policy can gate `publish` on (soma §5.1).
